```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(lm.beta)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(psych)

library(BifactorIndicesCalculator)
library(MVN)
library(polycor)
library(rsample)
```

```{r}
#Importing datasets and joining them: @nykmate
english <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_english_clean.csv") %>%
  filter(caff_intox_revised_13 == 4) %>%
  mutate(sample = "English") %>%
  select(PROLIFIC_PID, sample, age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

hungarian <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_clean copy.csv") %>%
  filter(if_all(
      all_of(paste0("caff_intox_revised_", 1:12)),
      ~ !is.na(.x)), age != 99) %>%
  mutate(caff_sens = factor(caff_sens, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  mutate(sample = "Hungarian") %>%
  select(PARTICIPANT_ID, sample, age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

caff_sens_invariance <- bind_rows(english, hungarian)
```

```{r}
caff_sens_invariance$sample <- factor(
  caff_sens_invariance$sample,
  levels = c("Hungarian", "English")
)
```

```{r}
#Defining model
bifactor_model_invariance <- '

  G =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
       caff_intox_revised_2 +
       caff_intox_revised_3 +
       caff_intox_revised_4 +
       caff_intox_revised_5 +
       caff_intox_revised_6 +
       caff_intox_revised_7 +
       caff_intox_revised_8 +
       caff_intox_revised_9 +
       caff_intox_revised_10 +
       caff_intox_revised_12

  F1 =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
        caff_intox_revised_4 +
        caff_intox_revised_6

  F2 =~ caff_intox_revised_5 +
        caff_intox_revised_6 +
        caff_intox_revised_7 +
        caff_intox_revised_8 +
        caff_intox_revised_9 +
        caff_intox_revised_10 +
        caff_intox_revised_12

  G ~~ 0*F1
  G ~~ 0*F2
  F1 ~~ 0*F2
'
```

```{r}
#Configural model testing
syntax_config <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_invariance,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  group = "sample",
  ordered = invariance_items,
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016"
)

fit_configural <- cfa(
  bifactor_model_invariance,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = invariance_items,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

summary(
  fit_configural,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#Metric model testing
syntax_metric <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_invariance,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  group = "sample",
  ordered = invariance_items,
  parameterization = "theta",
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  group.equal = c("thresholds")
)

fit_metric <- cfa(
  as.character(syntax_metric),
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = invariance_items,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

summary(
  fit_metric,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
comparison <- compareFit(
  fit_configural,
  fit_metric
)

summary(comparison)
```

```{r}
#Scalar model testing
syntax_scalar <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = bifactor_model_invariance,
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  group = "sample",
  ordered = invariance_items,
  parameterization = "theta", # vagy "delta"
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings")
)

fit_scalar <- cfa(
  as.character(syntax_scalar),
  data = caff_sens_invariance,
  group = "sample",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = invariance_items,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

summary(
  fit_scalar,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
comparison_2 <- compareFit(
  fit_metric,
  fit_scalar
)

summary(comparison_2)
```
